rationale: The only measured, workflow-scoped evidence that fits this repository is dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 reported ~20.4% elapsed savings). That optimization is already present in the workflow: the tests job caches Gradle (~/.gradle/caches, ~/.gradle/wrapper), Maven, and Protobuf, and the bazel job caches Bazel outputs/downloads, all with actions/cache@v6 and input-keyed restore keys. Re-adding a cache would be a duplicate/unrelated change. Other candidates lack verified prerequisites: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true) requires confirming that every matrix outcome is not required and that full diagnostics are not needed, but required_checks are not_verified and the workflow itself retains fail-fast: false; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT has no representative duration history to set a budget; P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is ci_service-scoped and needs separate branch-protection review. No new supported change preserves coverage and safety better than the current state.
